title: Armor Stand Preview Recipe
description: Before Armor Stands were officially added 'Searge' showcased it on twitter.
body:
# Armor Stand Preview Recipe

This is just a simple recipe data pack, nothing special.

5 August 2014 Searge showcased the armor stand on Twitter. It only require 6 sticks to be made.

- stick, stick, stick
- empty, stick, empty
- stick, empty, stick

**Side Note**: The game will most likely tell you that the data pack is out of data depending on the version you are choosing to play but it works just fine 1.13-1.20
